races.name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Dash (Handicap)
races.verdict:
FANDOM went close over C&D 2 starts back and could be the way to go with a line put through last week's Stewards' Cup run. All Ways Glamorous didn't see another rival here a fortnight ago and is a big player in his hat-trick bid. Kendall Roy and Bolo Neighs are also in the mix.

  1. FANDOM
  2. ALL WAYS GLAMOROUS
  3. KENDALL ROY

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Stayers (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
POLE STAR has dipped to 3 lb below his last winning mark and is worth chancing back at 2m with Dylan Browne McMonagle doing the steering. The thriving Shrimp Shady has the services of Ryan Moore and is feared most ahead of the Ian Williams pair Hermetic and Dancing In Paris.

  1. POLE STAR
  2. SHRIMP SHADY
  3. HERMETIC

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Challenge (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
This is wide open so it could pay to side with Richard Hannon's low-mileage STEM who got back to winning ways at Sandown last time and remains handily weighted on his first go over this distance. Both Insanity (second choice) and Night Breeze are past winners of this and seem sure to be on the premises again, while Castle Stuart is another with plenty to recommend him.

  1. STEM (IRE)
  2. INSANITY
  3. NIGHT BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Sprint (Handicap)
races.verdict:
The progressive THUNDER CALL was doing his best work at the finish when third at Newmarket last time and looks the one to be with, especially as this stiffer track promises to suit him even better. Red Spells Danger is likely to be on the premises again, while Anyasi strikes as the type to continue improving now entering handicap company and has to be feared.

  1. THUNDER CALL
  2. RED SPELLS DANGER (IRE)
  3. ANYASI

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Classic (Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HOSEKI is firmly on the up and is taken to defy a 5 lb rise to complete the 4-timer. Archers Bay finished with running left when short of room at Newmarket last time and rates the main danger, while Level Look has had excuses on his last 2 starts and may still have more to offer.

  1. HOSEKI (IRE)
  2. ARCHERS BAY (IRE)
  3. LEVEL LOOK

races.name: Dubai Duty Free Shergar Cup Mile (Handicap) (Rnd)
races.verdict:
BULLET POINT progressed into a smart handicapper last season and he would have finished a lot closer but for a troubled passage at Newbury in May, so he's well worth another chance. Last year's winner Ebt's Guard is second choice ahead of Ozat, who suffered severe interference at Glorious Goodwood last week.

  1. BULLET POINT
  2. EBT'S GUARD
  3. OZAT (FR)

races.name: Newsells Park Stud Sweet Solera Stakes (Fillies' Group 3)
races.verdict:
GRACEFUL SONG has the potential for considerable improvement on the back of her C&D debut success and can take the step up in class in her stride. Princess Margaret fourth Nuit d'Eclair could pose a big threat if her stamina holds now moving up to 7f. Martinet impressed with how she went about things at Thirsk and is next on the list.

  1. GRACEFUL SONG (USA)
  2. NUIT D'ECLAIR (IRE)
  3. MARTINET (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Epic Boost Nursery
races.verdict:
SANBONA WARRIOR was clear with a next-time-out winner at Doncaster and the handicapper may have taken a chance allowing him to start out in nurseries from a mark in the 70s. Betty Boop kept on strongly to score over 6f at York last month and is second choice ahead of Epsom maiden winner Eabha.

  1. SANBONA WARRIOR (IRE)
  2. BETTY BOOP (IRE)
  3. EABHA (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls 40,000 Pound EBF 'Newcomers' 'Confined' Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market will be informative here. Godolphin's DANSE ROYALE is preferred to expensive breeze-up purchase Lex Victoria and the Gosdens' Thi Qar before any betting clues are known.

  1. DANSE ROYALE
  2. LEX VICTORIA (IRE)
  3. THI QAR (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Extra Place Races Daily Handicap
races.verdict:
CASTLE ROCK has been off for over 9 months and sports headgear for the first time but his juvenile form reads very well and a mark of 89 could well underestimate him. He gets the vote over seasoned handicappers Angel Hunter, Sword, and Arctic Dawn, who all arrive at the top of their game.

  1. CASTLE ROCK
  2. ANGEL HUNTER
  3. SWORD

races.name: William Hill Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap
races.verdict:
DRYMEE is improving all the time and could still be ahead of the handicapper given the manner of his win at Newbury. Runswick and Go Rimbaud were not seen to best effect at Glorious Goodwood and are expected to fare much better here.

  1. DRYMEE
  2. RUNSWICK (IRE)
  3. GO RIMBAUD

races.name: Keep Your Raceday Positive Handicap
races.verdict:
BRAVE NATION offered something to work on starting out for this yard at Sandown and can end his losing run off a career-low mark. Merrimack was a good winner over C&D last week so looks the primary threat despite a career-high mark.

  1. BRAVE NATION (IRE)
  2. MERRIMACK
  3. THORNABY PEARL

races.name: William Hill Price Boosts Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
JACK LANGLEY has made a very positive start for his current yard and can quickly resume winning ways having just failed at Nottingham 5 weeks ago. Fram Castle has a similar profile to the selection so is second choice.

  1. JACK LANGLEY
  2. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)
  3. PRINCE QUATTRO (IRE)

races.name: Saint Lucia Let Her Inspire You Handicap
races.verdict:
An interesting race, with SI WHITE taken to resume winning ways over a longer trip which should suit. Similar comments regarding trip apply to Last Flight, who did well to finish as close as she did at Wolverhampton last month, whilst Femme Fatale improved upped to 2m last time and is also considered.

  1. SI WHITE (GER)
  2. LAST FLIGHT
  3. FEMME FATALE

races.name: Hyatt Inclusive Handicap
races.verdict:
SUNLIT SEA has looked more straightforward when winning her last 2 starts and seems to have been found a good opportunity to complete the hat-trick. Carefree Dream found 0-85 company beyond her at Ascot last time but had been in decent form at this lower level beforehand and might be the one to chase the selection home.

  1. SUNLIT SEA
  2. CAREFREE DREAM
  3. GUERNSEY LADY (IRE)

races.name: Bay Gardens Handicap
races.verdict:
HALIMEDE looks a typical improver for the Prescott yard and having got off the mark on handicap debut at Catterick earlier in the week, appeals as one who can now run up a sequence. Shopaholic and Darkest Red can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. HALIMEDE (IRE)
  2. SHOPAHOLIC
  3. DARKEST RED

races.name: Calabash Cove EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
KANZI was the only newcomer in the race when a promising second at Ayr and she has been found a good opportunity to go one better. With the other experienced runners in the line-up showing very little ability, Ozone Friendly and Saffron Bay are tipped to fill the frame on debut.

  1. KANZI
  2. OZONE FRIENDLY
  3. SAFFRON BAY (AUS)

races.name: Hewanorra Handicap
races.verdict:
HUSCAL has been running well on turf of late and is potentially on a good mark back on all-weather given his form at Kempton last autumn. Arantes Nascimento and Tattie Bogle look best of the others.

  1. HUSCAL (IRE)
  2. ARANTES NASCIMENTO
  3. TATTIE BOGLE

races.name: Rodney Bay Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
A LOTT OF KANE looked better than ever after a breathing operation when a decisive winner of a Wolverhampton handicap recently and he looks capable of defying a penalty in this company. Horus and Henry Tudor can battle for minor honours.

  1. A LOTT OF KANE (IRE)
  2. HORUS
  3. HENRY TUDOR

races.name: Watch Racing TV In Stunning HD Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
RAGGAAS is well bred and has shown a level of form which might prove good enough here if able to cope with the drop back in trip. Yimmna, an expensive purchase, looks much more interesting than the rest given her connections.

  1. RAGGAAS
  2. YIMMNA (FR)
  3. VASTERN

races.name: Celebrate The Life Of Ann Allport Handicap
races.verdict:
SAXON GRACE shaped with plenty of promise when third at Hamilton a week ago and is unexposed beyond 7f so could prove too good for Park Lane Penny and Here Comes Louie.

  1. SAXON GRACE (IRE)
  2. PARK LANE PENNY (IRE)
  3. HERE COMES LOUIE

races.name: Marske Fabrications & Engineering Straight Mile Handicap
races.verdict:
This is wide open. FRANKIES DREAM hasn't enjoyed the rub of the green on his last 2 runs at York and Ascot and can now capitalise on a handy-looking mark and gain a first win of 2026. Last year's victor Paladin teed himself up well for a repeat when runner-up at Ascot and heads the list of dangers. Illy's Roo, Capital Guarantee and Welbury can all play a prominent role too in this highly competitive event.

  1. FRANKIES DREAM (IRE)
  2. PALADIN (IRE)
  3. ILLY'S ROO (IRE)

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
DEMOCRACY DILEMMA showed he's in good heart at Goodwood last time and this is a much lower grade than he's faced for a long time so he could prove very hard to peg back. Spring Is Sprung is another class dropper and could give him most to think about.

  1. DEMOCRACY DILEMMA (IRE)
  2. SPRING IS SPRUNG (FR)
  3. SPORTS COACH (IRE)

races.name: Market Cross Jewellers Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
DORALEE won this race last year and is in good enough form to think she can follow up at the expense of a couple dropping to this level for the first time, namely Ellie's De Vega and Gwen Tennyson.

  1. DORALEE
  2. ELLIE'S DE VEGA
  3. GWEN TENNYSON (IRE)

races.name: Remembering Christine And Colin Brown Handicap
races.verdict:
NEWPORT has yet to score in this sphere but scored over hurdles earlier this summer and could prove the way to go on the back of an encouraging fourth at York recently. Dubai Venture arrives at the top of his game and rates a big threat though, while veteran Billy Bathgate can also play a prominent role on the back of his recent course victory.

  1. NEWPORT
  2. DUBAI VENTURE (IRE)
  3. BILLY BATHGATE

races.name: Watch Race Replays On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
FRENCH AFFAIR took his form up a notch when making a winning start for Jennie Candlish at Glorious Goodwood and can make light of a 3 lb weights rise. In-form Masaban could emerge as the one to chase him home ahead of Brave Traveller and Space Bear.

  1. FRENCH AFFAIR (IRE)
  2. MASABAN (IRE)
  3. BRAVE TRAVELLER

races.name: A McKie Builders EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not a maiden that will take much winning and ROMAN CRYSTAL might be the way to go as she leaves the impression she has a bigger effort in her. Ponte Carlo's best run has come on the all-weather but he looks a big player in this company. Beechwood Glory and newcomer Lone Striker are also of interest.

  1. ROMAN CRYSTAL (IRE)
  2. PONTE CARLO (IRE)
  3. BEECHWOOD GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Sunday Roast At Western House Hotel Handicap
races.verdict:
HARRY MOLE ran another excellent race in a higher grade at Chester a fortnight ago, doing best of those ridden close up and not beaten far in a blanket finish. He surely won't remain a maiden for much longer and this could be the day he gets his head in front. King of The Jungle and Midnight Lir are a couple of the dangers.

  1. HARRY MOLE
  2. KING OF THE JUNGLE (IRE)
  3. MIDNIGHT LIR (IRE)

races.name: Book Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Ladies Day Handicap
races.verdict:
TIGER ran out an emphatic winner at Chester last weekend and has obvious claims under a penalty. There are some intriguing 3-y-os in opposition however, namely Phantom Shadow, Unchartedterritory and Faeberon, all last-time-out winners.

  1. TIGER (FR)
  2. PHANTOM SHADOW (FR)
  3. UNCHARTEDTERRITORY (IRE)

races.name: Unite Ewing Hope's Happy Retirement Handicap
races.verdict:
JANNAS JOURNEY wasn't seen to best effect in a small field at Hamilton last time and remains well treated on last season's peak course form. Class-dropping David O'Meara pair Theoryofeverything and Walsingham are interesting at the top of the weights. Military Leader's consistent record this year suggests he's also likely to be on the premises.

  1. JANNAS JOURNEY (IRE)
  2. THEORYOFEVERYTHING
  3. WALSINGHAM (IRE)

races.name: Christmas Parties At Western House Hotel Handicap
races.verdict:
If MR COOL is in the same form as when scoring over C&D last week he may be able to cope with a 4 lb rise. Lanarra was only 1¼ lengths behind the selection in third on that occasion and may provide the chief threat ahead of Impressor, whose chance would increase should any further rain ease the ground.

  1. MR COOL (IRE)
  2. LANARRA (IRE)
  3. IMPRESSOR (IRE)

races.name: Book The Ladbrokes Ayr Gold Cup Handicap
races.verdict:
BLACK STORM won't need to pull out much more for blinkers to land a first handicap success. Runninsonofagun posted 3 good efforts over 1m here last month and his run style points to him being as effective back at shorter. Milford Grange will also have a say if recapturing the form he showed when second to Circle of Trust over C&D in June.

  1. BLACK STORM (IRE)
  2. RUNNINSONOFAGUN (IRE)
  3. MILFORD GRANGE

races.name: Festive Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Classified Stakes
races.verdict:
WICKLOW WAY is 2-2 in classified races - both victories coming at Newcastle - and he can defy a penalty to follow up his win there last week. Irish raider Patrick Street and Flying Moonlight are also shortlisted.

  1. WICKLOW WAY (IRE)
  2. PATRICK STREET
  3. FLYING MOONLIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Betway Leigh Handicap
races.verdict:
BRIGHTON VIEW won a small-field event at Yarmouth in good fashion on Sunday and William Knight's progressive colt can follow up over this shorter trip. Saxophonist is holding his form well and can prove the biggest threat ahead of Relentless Hero.

  1. BRIGHTON VIEW
  2. SAXOPHONIST (IRE)
  3. RELENTLESS HERO

races.name: Betway Rose Of Lancaster Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
SALLAAL looked a Group horse in a handicap when bolting up at Epsom and having since landed the odds in listed company, he is strongly fancied to bring up the hat-trick. Danger Bay is highly respected after his eye-catching John Smith's Cup effort, with Nahraan also worth another chance to confirm his 3-y-o form.

  1. SALLAAL (IRE)
  2. DANGER BAY (IRE)
  3. NAHRAAN

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Dick Hern Stakes (Fillies' & Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
FALLEN ANGEL was disappointing on her return in the Middleton Stakes but the form that saw her win 3 Group 1s last season would have her levels above some smart opponents here and the percentage call is to side with her again. The unexposed Alobayyah is highly respected after her Royal Ascot success, with the returning Calendar Girl also of interest on the back of a positive juvenile season.

  1. FALLEN ANGEL
  2. ALOBAYYAH
  3. CALENDAR GIRL

races.name: Betway Ashton Heath Handicap
races.verdict:
MOONSHINE is improving and can notch up a third win of the year. Crimson Spirit has developed into a really likeable type and can go well again having won a big-field Goodwood handicap last week.

  1. MOONSHINE (IRE)
  2. CRIMSON SPIRIT
  3. CHRISTIAN DAVID (IRE)

races.name: Betway Tanners Bridge Handicap
races.verdict:
NORCROSS BROW hasn't looked back since joining Charlie Clover and is weighted to notch a third win for the yard and edge out Black Endeavour, who didn't enjoy the rub of the green when sixth at Newbury last time. Both Norfolk Blue and Galba can also have a big say in this highly competitive handicap.

  1. NORCROSS BROW
  2. BLACK ENDEAVOUR (IRE)
  3. NORFOLK BLUE (IRE)

races.name: Betway Capital City Handicap
races.verdict:
Richard Hannon's lightly-raced LOST SIGNAL has been freshened up since coming in seventh in the German 2000 Guineas in May and looks to start life in handicaps on a good mark so gets the nod in this wide-open contest. Yorkshire is feared most on the back of a resurgent Doncaster second, although Financer, Leadman and Inspired all need factoring in too.

  1. LOST SIGNAL (IRE)
  2. YORKSHIRE (IRE)
  3. FINANCER

races.name: Betway Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SUGGY still looked well ahead of his mark when bagging a third all-weather victory of 2026 at Wolverhampton last week and is worth siding with to go in again back on turf. In-form duo Sandy Craic (second choice) and Phantom Watch seem sure to be on the premises too.

  1. SUGGY
  2. SANDY CRAIC (IRE)
  3. PHANTOM WATCH (IRE)

races.name: Wexford Fillies Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
It might be worth siding with Listowel bumper winner TELL THE BOYS to get the better of Felicity Smoak, who is clear form pick of those with hurdle experience but sets no more than a fair standard. Banner Beauty could also have a say if she can translate her Flat ability to hurdling.

  1. TELL THE BOYS (IRE)
  2. FELICITY SMOAK (IRE)
  3. BANNER BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: Shamrock Farm Enterprises Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
OCEAN MURPHY showed improved form when getting off the mark over C&D 16 days ago and can follow up despite a 6lb rise. Morell River has won on both visits to this course and rates the main danger, whilst Marian Avenue may still have more to offer at this trip.

  1. OCEAN MURPHY
  2. MORELL RIVER (IRE)
  3. MARIAN AVENUE (IRE)

races.name: Wexford Racecourse Park Run Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
NADIA'S BOY made a pleasing start over fences at this course in June and looks sure to be hard to beat if building on that effort now upped in trip. William Tell needs to prove he can put a clean round of jumping together but is well capable of troubling the selection should that be the case, whilst it will be interesting to see what the market makes of Kelya on chasing debut.

  1. NADIA'S BOY (IRE)
  2. WILLIAM TELL (IRE)
  3. KELYA (FR)

races.name: Wexfordraces.ie Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
LEAVE IN SECRET ran well when third at Galway 11 days ago and is taken to go close in this far less competitive scenario. Oneforgonzo won over fences at Killarney in May and looks the main danger, while Beggars Rock is respected back in this sphere.

  1. LEAVE IN SECRET (IRE)
  2. ONEFORGONZO (IRE)
  3. BEGGARS ROCK (IRE)

races.name: Poolcourt Engineering Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ROCKONLIAM has thrived of late, following a handicap hurdle success at Listowel with a smooth 14-runner maiden chase victory here 39 days ago, jumping soundly throughout. Whilst this represents a significant step up in trip, he remains open to further improvement and can go in again. Teenage Kiss and Rue Taylor, who fought out the finish of a handicap here in June head the list of dangers.

  1. ROCKONLIAM (IRE)
  2. TEENAGE KISS (IRE)
  3. RUE TAYLOR (FR)

races.name: BOYLE Sports Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A quickish turnaround after a long absence is a bit of a concern for RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE but he looked every bit as good as ever for his new yard when second over hurdles here and has obvious claims off the same mark back chasing. Last month's course 1-2 Ballybrittas and Lady Doyanne are likely to have a say again along with last year's winner Bynx.

  1. RIGHTFOLKSPLEASE (IRE)
  2. BALLYBRITTAS (IRE)
  3. LADY DOYANNE (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again 28th August Fillies Flat Race
races.verdict:
Newcomer ALICIOUS hails from a top stable with an outstanding record in bumpers and gets the nod before market clues. Honey Buck's shaped with promise when runner-up on debut at Cork last month and can put that experience to good use. Hee Hiles is another debutant to note, particularly if the market speaks in her favour.

  1. ALICIOUS (FR)
  2. HONEY BUCK'S (IRE)
  3. HEE HILES (IRE)

races.name: Well Of Moate Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
CAPTAIN HANLEY hasn't had things go entirely his way since bumping into a subsequent winner on his Clonmel hurdling debut and could well be the answer arriving on the back of a creditable effort on the Flat. The drop in trip is a concern for Facile Ocean given how he's been shaping but he still has leading claims on form nonetheless. Newcomer Digby Bridge also warrants a close look in the betting.

  1. CAPTAIN HANLEY (IRE)
  2. FACILE OCEAN (IRE)
  3. DIGBY BRIDGE

races.name: Kieran Kelly Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
CORKBEG is back down to a good mark on the pick of last season's efforts and, with a recent outing likely to have sharpened him up, he's fancied to snap a long losing run. Syosset was unlucky to bump into a handicap blot at Cork 5 days ago and seems sure to be on the premises once more, while Surviving Murmansk completes the shortlist.

  1. CORKBEG (IRE)
  2. SYOSSET (IRE)
  3. SURVIVING MURMANSK (IRE)

races.name: Bernard Kenny Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
TYSON FURY is still to score over hurdles, but he turned in another respectable effort in spite drop in trip at Galway last week and looks the one to beat back up in distance in this weaker maiden. Mont Star and Cooladdi are considered the main threats.

  1. TYSON FURY
  2. MONT STAR (FR)
  3. COOLADDI (IRE)

races.name: Joe Cooney Memorial Hurdle
races.verdict:
PETS GEORGINA scored in a really good style at Killarney 3 weeks ago and she's fancied to complete the hat-trick given the current concerns about the attitude of Rocky's Diamond, who would otherwise set a clear standard in this company.

  1. PETS GEORGINA (IRE)
  2. ROCKY'S DIAMOND (IRE)
  3. DRUMGILL (IRE)

races.name: Smiddys Pub Mullingar Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ANODANDAWINK impressed when winning a big-field Wexford handicap on just his second chase start last month and he gets the verdict over Zolpharine, who was at the top of his game when last seen in May. Mistyburn also caught the eye at Galway last week and merits respect in a hot race.

  1. ANODANDAWINK (IRE)
  2. ZOLPHARINE (IRE)
  3. MISTYBURN (IRE)

races.name: KEPAK Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A few with chances but in-form MICKIE ANGEL rates the pick of the weights back in handicap company so edges the vote from Emmet Mullins' new recruit A Law Of Her Own, who got no further than the first at Galway last week and remains with potential for new connections. Ceanndana and Rexam can both play a prominent role too.

  1. MICKIE ANGEL (IRE)
  2. A LAW OF HER OWN (IRE)
  3. CEANNDANA (IRE)

races.name: Connellan & Noone Solicitors LLP Longford Flat Race
races.verdict:
APPY WAYS is from a successful family her yard knows well and is taken to emulate her half-sister Appy Getaway by making a winning start. Mr Enigma is pick of those with experience, though Inishtearaght is clearly thought capable of better.

  1. APPY WAYS (IRE)
  2. MR ENIGMA (IRE)
  3. INISHTEARAGHT (IRE)

Prix De La Porte De Vitry - Attele
